title: docs(pm-dispatch): the Writes: line names the relay as the only GitHub write path and bans GitHub MCP writes by name; the card thread's opening message carries it verbatim; contract review notes a PR not authored by the fleet bot
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DArLC1mq7jXYPE9impmGwHb)_

Fixes #25457

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:把您 2026-10-23 14:43Z 的话「在每张卡的派发令里写明『PR 只经中继 `pr_create` 开,禁用 MCP』」写进 pm-dispatch 四个细则文件。① 派发令的 `Writes:` 行现在点名:PR 只经中继 `pr_create`,评论/标签/正文只经中继写工具;⛔ GitHub MCP 写工具逐个点名(`create_pull_request`、`update_pull_request`、`issue_write`、`add_issue_comment` 等);多仓项目线程不加载仓库 `settings.json` 的 deny,这一行就是唯一防线。② 卡线程开场消息里的派发令必须逐字带这条 `Writes:` 行。③ 契约复核记录多一笔:PR 作者不是 `objectstack-fleet[bot]` 时,③ 注点名该登录名(脱中继写),席位落地前先读到。④ 顺带把 `coordinator.md` 车道归属那两行改成和 #25427 写的无条件接管一致:座位贴 🟢 写着别的账号就是车道已有主,⛔ 不坐别席,但维护者改写项目指令行即按 `project-forms.md` 接管(含在飞卡)。
- **为什么改**:实测 #25427 由卡线程经 GitHub MCP `create_pull_request` 开出,作者变成个人登录名而不是车队 bot;原因是以多个检出为根的项目线程不加载 `objectstack/.claude/settings.json`,仓库里的 MCP 写禁令与 PreToolUse 守卫在那里失效,技能文本是唯一防线。原 `Writes:` 行只说「只走 REST 代理」,没点名 `pr_create`,也没按名禁 MCP 写工具。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯规则文本,不碰代码与门禁逻辑;`execution-duties.md` 188/188(+3 −2,两行合一行付账)、`contract-review.md` 54→55/60(+1)、`dispatch-runbook.md` 与 `coordinator.md` 就地改行、行数不变;无上限抬高;一次 revert 可回。要您知道的一处:`coordinator.md` L12–13 原文「另一项目在飞卡由其席跟完,其收班简报在即可坐」与 #25427 的「接管不等撞墙账号」相抵触,本 PR 按席位复核记录 6368204690 ③-1 的建议改写:默认仍由原席跟完在飞卡,只有您改写指令行时才无条件接管。
- **席位意见**:(席位复核后填)
- **你要做的(一个动作)**:无。您 14:14Z 已在席位线程授权「后续按 pm-dispatch 规则审核通过的都可以落地」;本 PR 在 #25422 合入、合 main 后由席位复核 PASS、CI 全绿即落地。环境级设置(禁 MCP 写、放行中继命令)仍是您亲手改,不在本 PR。

## What changed

Four files under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**`, rule text only, every edited line at or under 120 bytes, no ceiling row moved.

| File | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `execution-duties.md` 派发 (187 → 188, ceiling 188) | L130 「派发令恒带 `Writes:` 行:只走 REST 代理、写预算(端点清单)、`mcp_calls` 计数,dev 两数都报」 | Three lines in its place: the `Writes:` line names the relay's `pr_create` as the only PR path and the relay write tools as the only path for comments, labels and body edits, and still asks for both counts; a ⛔ line names the GitHub MCP write tools (`create_pull_request`, `update_pull_request`, `issue_write`, `add_issue_comment`, …); a third line says a multi-repo project thread does not load the repo's `settings.json` deny, so the `Writes:` line is the only guard, and defines the two counts (write budget, `mcp_calls`). Paid in the same file: the two 派发词 lines at L121–L122 merged into one (116 bytes) keeping increments only, ⛔ no whole-body paste, the dev reading the full card and every comment, the dev's own completeness check, and the runbook pointer |
| `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈卡线程〉 (241, net 0) | 「派发令由 coordinator 写进卡线程开场消息,⛔ 不落共享目录;卡上派发评论留一行指针」 | 「…写进线程开场消息,`Writes:` 行逐字在内,⛔ 不落共享目录;卡上留指针」 (in place, 119 bytes) |
| `contract-review.md` 复核归属与资格 (54 → 55 on the merged head, ceiling 60) | ①②③ items | +1 after ③: a PR whose `user.login` is not `objectstack-fleet[bot]` gets a ③ note naming that login (an off-relay write), read by the seat before landing. Placed in `contract-review.md` rather than `review-checklist.md` (77/77, no headroom) |
| `coordinator.md` 一、车道归属 (49 lines, net 0; the file carries no CEILINGS row) | L12 「一条车道恒归一个项目:车道任一座位贴 🟢 标着另一项目 ⇒ 车道已有主,⛔ 不坐别席」; L13 「仲裁者是座位贴,⛔ 不是项目记忆;另一项目在飞卡由其席跟完,其收班简报在即可坐」 | L12 「一车道归一项目:座位贴 🟢 写他账号 ⇒ 车道已有主;仲裁者是座位贴,⛔ 不是项目记忆」; L13 「⛔ 不坐别席,另一项目在飞卡由其席跟完;维护者指令行改写 ⇒ 按 `project-forms.md` 接管」 (both in place; the seat's review record 6368204690 ③-1 on #25427 asked for this alignment, and the claim on the card names it) |

Acceptance reads on this head: `git grep -n 'create_pull_request' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch` → one hit, `execution-duties.md` L130, the ⛔ line. `git grep -n 'os-bill\|hotlong\|os-elon-musk' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/` → no hit.

## Gates

Head `684b081c` = content commit `5ea4c1c` + merges of `origin/main` after #25427 (`c246fb07`) and #25422 (`a7da5b92`) + the ③-1 line (`684b081c`). The head's check-runs are the record: on `a7da5b92` all 35 check-runs completed, 25 `success` and 10 `skipped`, none failed (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` all `success`); the contract review record on that head is comment 6370282626 (PASS). Locally on `684b081c`, each exit code captured before any pipe: `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` ✓ (`execution-duties.md` 188/188, `dispatch-runbook.md` 241/241, `contract-review.md` 55/60; no line over 120 bytes), `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` ✓, `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` ✓, `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness` ✓, `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose` ✓, `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` ✓. On the content commit, `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 17 commands, 17 run, 17 × exit 0 after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and a build of `@objectstack/formula` + `@objectstack/lint`, reconciled with `--ran`. No published package moves (`.claude/**` only), so `skip-changeset`.

## Ordering and open PRs

- Lands after #25422 (card #25414), which edits `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈巡查常设项〉/〈分诊两级盘点〉 (L39–L50, L64–L71) and `contract-review.md` 独立性对/落地前检 (L35–L41). This PR's hunks are `dispatch-runbook.md` L140 and `contract-review.md` L29, outside those; `main` is merged in here once #25422 lands, before the seat's review.
- #25427 (card #25412) was in the merge queue at this push; its `project-forms.md` is what `coordinator.md` L13 now points to, and `main` is merged in once it lands too.
- Tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` on `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`: "MANDATORY", as the claim records; governed rule text under `contract-review.md` 档随面定).

## Acceptance notes

- The body's first line is the HTML-comment attribution block the project session requires; `os-dev.md` 〈干净收尾〉 forbids HTML comments in GitHub text. Reported as a deviation, not hidden.
- `execution-duties.md` L121's merge keeps every clause of the two old lines (the completeness check was restored at the reviewer's ③-1 spelling in `684b081c`).
- The commit carries the model-free trailer pair the pre-push hook requires and no card trailer; the card relation is this body's `Fixes` line only.
- Opened through the fleet-write relay `pr_create` (the rule this PR writes), so the author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; every later write to this PR goes through the relay too.
- Governed surface `.claude/**` (Tier S): draft, awaiting the seat's `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review after the `main` merge; landing by the seat under the maintainer's 14:14Z standing word in the seat thread; ⛔ not to be flipped ready, queued or armed by this thread.
